description: Open a new tab in THIS session's browser window and return its handle. Pass that handle as "tab" on every call that should drive it; calls without "tab" keep driving the current tab. A sub-agent opens its own tab this way so two agents never share a page.

active.description: Bring the tab to the front of the window (default: true).

url.description: The page to open (default: a blank tab).

name: new_tab
